i5607.title: [NativeFace L2] Make native focus and overflow navigable and legible
i5607.body:
Parent #5357. 

## Scope
Preserve keyboard/pointer focus, visible selection, clipping/pagination/scroll indication and secondary details for all current source actions.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Keyboard-only traversal reaches all offered actions/details.
- [ ] Overflow never silently hides important semantics.
- [ ] Stale/unavailable/refused states visibly distinct.

## Boundaries
No color-only focus or host-owned state.

Depends on canonical Face #5356; coordinate overlapping native scene files with Patchbay layout #5358/#5512.

A closing PR should be one independently observable result with source-pinned focused proof.

---

## Crèche interaction and panel proof (2026-10-18)

The normal QEMU Crèche currently visually conflates focus, selection and availability, and the fourth selected Plot is offscreen. Coordinate #5989 (actual Boolean checked controls) and #5990 (responsive semantic panels); source editor/review corrections belong to #5991.

Add to this ticket's focus/overflow acceptance rather than recoding their source/renderer implementation:
- [ ] Keyboard-only traversal reaches Body name, naming tradition, Suggest, search, every eligible Plot choice, review/details and Birth across both columns and all pages without changing the source-defined meaningful reading order.
- [ ] Checked versus unchecked, focused versus unfocused and available versus unavailable each have distinguishable non-color cues; a checked square is **not** just an action-row outline.
- [ ] Pointer and keyboard activation of a verified reversible Boolean choice both return the correct **current** action/one-Boolean-argument binding; focus and pagination are Mask-local, and successful source mutation requires a new acknowledged Show (implementation #5989, source action path #5604).
- [ ] The fourth and later Plot names are reachable without silent clipping; show explicit page/continuation context, preserve focus by stable action identity after refresh and do not lose selected items during search/review.
- [ ] Narrow/large-Unicode and long inventory specimens preserve access to primary Birth, its unavailable reason, all details, and safe deterministic fallback; no additional graphics command budget.

Do not add independent UI state or host-owned toggles. The returned typed action always belongs to the fresh authoritative Face/Show.

i5992.title: [VisualLook · Native Type] Add a bounded serif/sans/mono typographic ensemble to ConduitOS
i5992.body:
Parent: #5366 (visual Look). Native experience companion: #5357. Architectural contracts: #5364 (Face/structural component/Look separation), #5368 (multimodal Look), #5367 (accessibility), #5627/#5628 (canonical visual Look migration/selection). Accepted native font foundation: #3163 **closed**. This is a focused enhancement, **not** a font engine replacement.

## Outcome

Give the real ConduitOS graphical Mask an intentional, legible **typographic ensemble**, instead of sizing the same Sans family for nearly all content:

- **Editorial / display:** a pinned, appropriately licensed serif for source-owned titles, Body names or introductory text when selected by the visual Look.
- **Interface / actions:** current clean proportional sans for controls, headings, labels, actions and ordinary information.
- **Exact / technical:** existing pinned monospace for code, diagnostic identifiers, typed quantities and similar exact technical text when semantically appropriate.
- **Annotation / human voice (optional bounded enhancement):** a real, pinned italic for appropriate source-authored help/annotation emphasis, *not* fake italic from shear and not a new authoritative semantic role.

The goal is expressive diversity, not more type sizes. Demonstrate a restrained *editorial/literary* Look versus a spare *engineering* Look over the **same** Face and checked structural component recipe. Look selects appearance; Face never names font files/families, and changing typography never invents text, action, state, navigation or accessible roles.

## Source audit and finite implementation

1. Inspect **current `dev`** before editing: `targets/conduitos/src/display/typography.rs`, `display/typography/{layout,raster,scene}.rs`, `targets/conduitos/build/typography.rs`, `assets/graphical/{manifest.json,README.md}`, `assets/fonts/dejavu/`, `native_face_scene/{document,layout,frame}.rs`, and current Look admission/selected Host. There are currently five runtime purposes (`Label,Body,Heading,Title,Code`), but **manifest and make-time profile descriptions are not necessarily one identical format**; reconcile active product path and provenance instead of blindly changing one file or assuming a checked-in atlas is used by runtime.
2. Choose the smallest pinned compatible **serif** family and, if useful and bounded, italic style. DejaVu Serif from audited DejaVu 2.37 is one candidate; do not assume a font's licensing or coverage without inspecting source files. Record upstream source, release, immutable hashes, license/attribution and distribution rules. Never share system or arbitrary user fonts and do not load ambient fonts at runtime.
3. Extend build-time rasterized immutable glyph/profile resources with explicit family/style selection **below** Face, via finite admitted Host font offers and chosen visual Look where already supported. Keep allocation-free render-time lookup and deterministic rescue/fallback. Do not add a font manager, unbounded shaping, OpenType engine, runtime downloads or caches.
4. Reuse existing `GraphicsTextRole` purpose and source-owned prose; decide if present native `TextRole` mappings for status/action/annotation need distinct *presenter* profiles without expanding the semantic Face vocabulary. For italic, require defensible source-derived emphasis/help or a checked, presentation-only style slot, not guessed by regex or rewritten content. If this would require a new cross-Mask text meaning, split that upstream contract rather than hiding it inside renderer.
5. Typography changes must use the **same font-specific metrics for measure, wrap, position, clip and paint**. Look swaps trigger new measured/layout-admitted Show and safe reflow; preserve selection/focus/source order, all hit regions and full accessible/nonvisual fallback. The native reader must remain capable of correctly rendering Crèche Unicode names, combining marks/fallback and long labels.
6. Reuse and explicitly budget the existing fixed native system (including currently documented <=4 MiB coverage, <=1024 admitted scalars, <=64-pixel glyph extent where applicable), graphics leaf limits (48 commands, 192-byte text) and finite compositor surfaces. Any budget change must be justified and admitted *before Play* with measured image size/RAM/frame cost, not a quiet limit raise.
7. Browser can use its own admitted fonts/CSS; the two Hosts need consistent **expression intent**, not pixel or glyph equality. Preserve the native headless exclusion and ordinary system rescue text path.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Normal ConduitOS x86_64 QEMU Crèche shows a truly different editorial serif for a display title or Body name, sans for actionable controls, mono for at least one exact technical specimen. Optional true italic only if its semantic source and glyph coverage are proven.
- [ ] Same checked Face + checked structural recipe + two admitted visual Looks yield distinct typographic character, with identical source names/actions/availability/typed interaction contracts and preserved focus/reading order. If #5627/#5628 prerequisites have not landed, deliver a bounded pinned-font mechanism first without inventing a provisional second Look engine; defer the Look-selection integration explicitly.
- [ ] Long/Unicode names, combining/fallback, narrow viewport, large text and unknown scalars are correctly measured and remain readable; unsupported glyph/style/provider yields an honest, usable fallback. No invented glyph coverage.
- [ ] Per-role glyph advances, line heights, reflow and paint use the same selected font metrics; no clipping, overlap, hitbox mismatch or hidden actions after Look change.
- [ ] Build provenance/hash/license verified; finite corpus, bytes and code size measured; repeated display frames require no runtime font parsing or growing allocations. Headless builds exclude font resources.
- [ ] Screenshots plus source-pinned normal QEMU build/boot/render receipts, focused text metrics/fallback tests and relevant exact-tree CI. Compare at least one before/after Crèche screenshot and one native engineering vs editorial Look where the Look contracts are admitted.

## Small PR / ownership

Prefer **one independently reviewable bounded native typography mechanism PR** first, then Look-selection proof in #5628/#5629; do not mix in #5989 checkbox semantics, #5990 grouping, #5991 Birth projection restructuring or a general UI framework. Follow #5520 thin-review policy and #5357 file ownership coordination. Link actual measured assets, not illustrations pretending to be runtime proof.

## Stop line

No Face font-family field, body-owned typographic state, new Button/Widget ontology, CSS in the kernel, runtime TTF loading, arbitrary downloadable fonts, unbounded atlas, fake claims of full complex-script shaping, or style-driven alteration of the semantic Face.

i5608.title: [NativeFace L3] Verify native layout failure fallback in real QEMU
i5608.body:
Parent #5357. 

## Scope
Exercise deliberate scene overflow, lost display/unavailable provider and normal ConduitOS screenshots; retain source-pinned compositor/input receipts.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Crèche/Home/Body snapshots from real QEMU show readable controls.
- [ ] Failure produces honest deterministic fallback, not forged Show.
- [ ] Existing native layout CI and compositor bounds remain green.

## Boundaries
No cosmetic-only proof substituting for actual input/scene run.

Depends on canonical Face #5356; coordinate overlapping native scene files with Patchbay layout #5358/#5512.

A closing PR should be one independently observable result with source-pinned focused proof.

---

## Crèche acceptance snapshots after B1–B3 (2026-10-18)

When #5989/#5990/#5991 are integrated, extend this **real installed QEMU** acceptance (do not block the existing independent fallback slice on unmerged children, or claim these enhancements complete early):
- [ ] Screenshot normal x86_64 Crèche at 1280×800: one clear source title, actual editable name affordance, two readable semantic panels, four checked starting Plots, one prominent Birth action and accurate readiness/count.
- [ ] Capture a real keyboard **and supported pointer** toggle on one Plot, correlating exact source Face/revision, acknowledged native Show, typed `value/bool=false` action, owner acceptance, new Show with **three** checked and correct ready/review text; repeat with `true` where available.
- [ ] Capture a narrow viewport, long Unicode name, search-filtered inventory, >4 Plots and keyboard traversal to all actions. No invisible fourth Plot or inaccessible selection; no duplicated visual title.
- [ ] Capture stale Show/unavailable action/incomplete argument refusal as separate cases, proving unchanged source draft and truthful visible error. A verified checkbox should not dispatch a missing Boolean argument; an actually incomplete text editor must still refuse.
- [ ] Scene/resource pressure (48 commands, 192-byte text, 8 retained surfaces), missing glyph/graphics provider and failure fallback retain exact Face meaning/agency and a source-pinned scanout/input/Host-Plan-Play receipt.

Compare required meaning with the deterministic linear/browser reconstruction per #5605; distinguish actual QEMU proof from CPU raster and fixture evidence.

i6039.title: [MaskControl C1] Admit bounded collections and source-owned selectable choices
i6039.body:
Parent #6038. Predecessors #5355 (semantic baseline), #5365/#5624 (checked component Fore), #5378 (Face-item projection), #5372 (trusted action return). Do **not** expand #5994's already-ordered 01–15 native UX route.

## Outcome
Use the existing Face Collection/Item subjects, Contains relations, typed properties, availability and exact action contracts to render **informational lists**, navigable collections and explicitly selectable **single/multiple choice** alternatives without pretending that every list is a listbox. A selected presentation component Fore/recipe binds source subjects and action slots; no universal Listbox Kind, new Body state or second ApplicationView.

## Implement
1. Audit existing source-derived Todo/Crèche/Birth list, `input/saved-choice`, `readable_finite_text_choices`, current owner Face choice groups and `ApplicationComponent::Select/Option`. Record what is already real, migration-only, and missing. Prefer reuse with one canonical Face rather than translating labels to application-specific pseudo-control state.
2. Pin ordered, finite item/option identities independently from labels; exact membership, selected values, enabled/refused state, exclusive vs multiple/independent semantics, grouping, cardinality, required/read-only limits, empty and overflow states, and one checked action per actual permitted source mutation. Selection and focus are distinct. A one-way complete action is not a reversible checkbox.
3. Where existing Face subject/property/action/Fore structures suffice, use them. If a genuinely cross-medium meaning is absent, document the exact failed reconstruction under `docs/architecture/face-grammar-conformance.md` **before** proposing a minimal grammar addition.
4. Finite viewport/page or virtualized realization retains stable identities, meaningful order, count/continuation and navigation. Mask-local focus/scroll/filter never silently edits source membership; source-owned search/query needs ordinary explicit typed operations.

## Acceptance
- [ ] One actual committed Todo or Crèche Face presents (a) read-only list, (b) source-authorized exclusive choice, (c) source-authorized reversible multi/independent choices as appropriate; values/actions survive generic and independent linear reconstruction. Do not invent domain actions merely to make a fixture pass.
- [ ] Distinct options with the **same label**, Unicode/long names, reordered items, 0/1/many items, selected/disabled/offscreen item, lost/changed membership, and finite overflow behave correctly. Existing `input/saved-choice` identity vs label behavior is not regressed.
- [ ] Only a current exact Show/revision/target action, with a checked permitted value, reaches ordinary owner mutation; missing/stale/forged options and bad cardinality refuse with **zero effects**.
- [ ] Focus/hover/list navigation alone does not commit selection; screen-free traversal reaches every meaningful action and exposes limitations.
- [ ] Focused tests, exact-source receipts and a handoff contract to browser W4 and native N4 are supplied.

Stop line: no hardcoded generic widget ontology in Face, no AppView v2, no role/ARIA supplied as semantic authority, no CSS/DOM/kernel GUI framework. One thin source/Fore proof PR per independently observable slice, under #5520.

i6040.title: [MaskControl C2] Compose checked text fields and editable suggestions without shadow state
i6040.body:
Parent #6038. Coordinates #5991 (already owns first real native Crèche Body-name action), C1 source choice/collection contract, `face/editor` in `docs/input-semantics.md`, #5372 trusted correspondence, #5367 accessibility, and #5376 selected browser realization.

## Outcome
Give checked components a reusable, exact contract for **single-line text entry**, **multiline revisioned editing** and **editable combobox suggestions**. This is a composition of existing typed `FaceActionArgument`, `text/document@1`/`text/edit@1` and finite source choice semantics, not a second edit kernel or application-owned widget state.

## Required distinctions
- An atomic named action argument (e.g. `creche.name`) differs from a document editor applying revisioned replacement ranges; both must be handled without one pretending to be the other.
- Mask-local field draft, selection/caret, visible popup, provisional IME composition, highlighted suggestion and current query are **not** authoritative selected value or committed document. Pending submission, acceptance, refusal and new acknowledged Show are separate.
- A **select-only combobox** accepts declared option identities. An **editable fixed-membership combobox** may type to search but must choose an admitted option. An **editable free-text combobox** may submit arbitrary text **only if the action's checked source contract allows it**. Never turn a suggestion, autocomplete display or label match into authority to change data.
- Local filtering is allowed only over explicitly admitted bounded options; a source-backed query must have its own checked Plot operation / Flow and version/limit. Unknown, stale and remote results cannot silently enter current choice membership.
- Validation/help/required/readonly/disabled and byte/Unicode bounds are source-backed. No eager commit of every keypress absent the authored action contract; transient UI-only drafts may be preserved across a harmless Show refresh but must never replay stale source authority.
- Browser can delegate text caret and IME to its native controls; native ConduitOS must declare unsupported editing/IME/caret capabilities rather than claim feature parity.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Actual source action `creche.name` (coordinate with #5991) or equivalently checked named text action uses a finite UTF-8 contract; edit draft and cancel do not mutate Body; valid submit commits once on fresh Show, invalid/oversized/stale/malformed or disabled submit does nothing.
- [ ] Existing Memory Lantern `face/editor` revisioned replacement, cursor and composition semantics survive one multiline manifestation; no second document buffer or conflicting meaning for text/edit.
- [ ] One finite fixed-membership editable suggestion specimen and one explicitly authorized free-text specimen distinguish typing, highlight, Escape/cancel, option choice, submission and source commit. Duplicate labels and option reorder preserve IDs. Browser vs generic screen-free presentations retain meaning.
- [ ] Unsupported host cap, IME composition pending, intervening external revision, focus loss, query pressure, invalid Unicode, truncated/empty input and replacement Show refuse or fall back with inspectable reason.
- [ ] Focused conformance and source-pinned proof before W4 or N4 declares the whole control family accepted.

Stop line: no universal `TextField` or `ComboBox` semantic Kind, no second scheduler, independent editor datastore, uncontrolled `contenteditable` or raw key event bypass to owner. Slice by atomic text first, then editable-combo composition, respecting #5520.

i6041.title: [WebComponent W4] Render portable choices and text controls in selected browser Backs
i6041.body:
Parent #6038. Browser-specific follow-on to #5376 and its W1 #5645 / W2 #5646 / W3 #5647; consumes C1/C2 portable control contracts, #5365 typed component Fores, #5378 checked assembly, #5372 Mask interlock, #5367 accessibility and #5379 CSS/Look.

## Outcome
With **one real committed Face**, compare generic browser controls to an **actually registered and selected Web Component** Back for source-derived list/choice, text-input, and one editable combobox. Both route current Show/revision/target/arguments through the **trusted existing browser Host binding**, not raw custom-element owner callbacks. Styles may differ by Look; selected values and permitted actions may not.

## Implementation
1. Reuse `targets/browser/handbook/owner-face-component.mjs`, current generic `application-face.mjs` migration evidence, HTML `input`/`textarea`/`select` and browser verified option/UTF-8 checks; **do not preserve two public application schemas** or implement a separate Form runtime.
2. Admit/instantiate a digest/version- and Host-offer-bound component implementation with exact required semantic slots, resource/depth/event caps and safe generic fallback. Registration is not itself accepted Show/interaction.
3. For the selected Back use browser-native control semantics where sufficient. For an editable popup follow the applicable WAI-ARIA APG combobox/listbox patterns and inspect the **real composed Shadow DOM** (accessible name/state, popup-expanded/active descendant/focus management, keyboard/caret/IME, long text/zoom), not just declarative role labels. A form-associated custom element is optional and needs its own actual admission/proof if used.
4. Keep current Body-owned source value and validation; local focus/query/composition/draft may be ephemeral. Both component and generic route use one source typed interaction ledger. Look/CSS cannot create, hide or retarget required source actions.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Packaged Chromium selects registered component Back and generic fallback from **the same** source-Face/Fore; record both present/Show/Play and actual keyboard/pointer traces, names, current choice and exact committed value.
- [ ] Informational list remains noninteractive without source action; single and multi choice, finite select, text field and editable suggestion have honest states and clearly different semantics.
- [ ] Fresh submission accepted once; focus/open/hover/IME preedit/cancel alone has no Body mutation. Reject forged Shadow event, unknown/duplicate option identity, stale Show, disabled source, bad typed argument, untrusted element, broken stylesheet, absent module, inaccessible control and over-capacity.
- [ ] Test narrow/large viewport, 200% zoom, long Unicode, keyboard-only, standard editable-key behavior, forced colors where supported, and generic screen-free fallback; do not assert universal WCAG compliance.
- [ ] Record source-pinned browser CI and honest browser-only scope, not native QEMU or hardware parity.

Do not change existing #5376 W1-W3 closure criteria or block native #5994. One narrow browser Back PR at a time under #5520.

i6042.title: [NativeFace N4] Prove source-bound lists, choice popups and text fields in real QEMU
i6042.body:
Parent #6038; native follow-on **after #5994's serial acceptance**, not a replacement for its current 01–15 path. Reuses #5991 Body name field, #5990 native grouped panels, #5607 focus/overflow, #5608 actual QEMU proof, #5989 reversible Boolean choices and merged #6031 native mouse; consumes portable C1/C2 contracts, #5372 interaction binding, #5367 accessibility and #5365 component recipes.

## Outcome
The **installed real x86_64 ConduitOS** graphical Mask can truthfully present and interact with bounded source-owned lists, exclusive/multiple choices, finite option navigation, and typed text entry, with one explicit minimal editable-combobox (input plus finite admitted suggestions) when actually supported. Unknown or unsupported sophisticated variants remain accurately usable via current source-backed generic/linear fallback or refuse honestly.

## Implementation
1. Follow Face -> checked component Fore/structural recipe -> admitted native Mask/Show -> typed `FaceInteraction`. Reuse `targets/conduitos/src/native_face_scene/{document,layout,input,frame}.rs`, source-bound Boolean click and cursor route. No magic Crèche-only widget adapter, new kernel UI library, DOM/CSS parser or shadow Body.
2. Store focus, page/scroll, popup openness, transient text/selection and draft only as bounded Mask-local state, with revisions checked at commit. Keyboard/pointer paths must send exactly the same typed action/value and cannot infer source choices by painted label or stale index.
3. On current Host, choose honest text editing capabilities (at minimum ordinary bounded name input). Grapheme navigation, true arbitrary-position editing, touch, OS-level IME, clipboard and wide dynamic suggestion lists may remain explicitly unsupported until individually proved. Display source-backed disabled, selected, focus and invalid states with non-color cues.
4. Use admitted finite list windows and deterministic one-column/fallback and continuation, respect existing measured layout, 48 GraphicsScene commands, 192-byte text/command, retained surface and font budgets. Long/Unicode names are reachable without silently clipping source actions. No blanket "native parity" inferred from Chromium.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Source-pinned **normal** QEMU Crèche or Todo journey: read finite list, navigate/inspect its item, change source-authorized choice by keyboard **and** pointer, edit named text, submit valid value, receive new acknowledged Show and source-owned state; compare same Face/identity with linear and browser generic.
- [ ] Source-independent focus/scroll/cancel/popup movement leaves Body unchanged; single and multi choice semantics remain distinct.
- [ ] Tests include 0/1/many options, duplicate labels and changed order, >viewport items, disabled controls, long Unicode, unsupported IME, stale Show and detached input, refused action, insufficient scene bytes and deterministic safe fallback; actual QEMU screenshot + checked source action trace required.
- [ ] No repeated activation while held, no fabricated second Body or action, no silent mutation on draft, source check/test and CI/release proof at exact revisions.
- [ ] Explicit ledger of what is emulated, browser-only, screen-free and unverified on physical hardware.

One active native scene implementation PR under #5520; may stage source/linear preparations while #5994 proceeds, but do not merge conflicting native scene edits prematurely.
